unsupported: Central Avenue Meats, based in Great Falls, Montana, with livestock operations in nearby Fort Shaw, was founded by Brent and Tracie Roeder as a first-generation family venture.
They manage the full cycle from livestock raising through meat processing, supplying both wholesale restaurant partners and direct-to-consumer customers.
The Roeders’ decision to focus on the Targhee breed reflects a commitment to producing a product that thrives in the area’s conditions, a differentiator they cite as central to their operation.
